**Safety parts we’ll add for this feature** | Feature | Safety part | |---|---| | **Photo uploads** | 1️⃣ Only the uploader can see, edit or delete their own images.
2️⃣ Restrict file type to jpg/png and size to ≤ 5 MB.
3️⃣ Store in a private bucket unless they want to share publicly. | | **Likes** | 1️⃣ Each user can like a photo only once.
2️⃣ The liker’s identity is kept private to everyone else. | | **Log‑in** | 1️⃣ Use Supabase Auth (magic‑link email) – no passwords, no own storage.
2️⃣ Set the site URL and redirect URLs in the Supabase settings. | | **Data ownership** | 1️⃣ Supabase Row‑Level Security (RLS) on the `photos` and `likes` tables so a user can only read/write their own rows. | | **Keys** | 1️⃣ All Supabase keys live in the server‑side only (`.env` or Lovable Secrets). | | **Save point** | Every change you make below will be a separate “save point” (Git commit or Lovable checkpoint). | --- ### Starter questions (Amber) > 1️⃣ **Who will use the app?** > a) Just me? > b) A small group (family, friends)? > c) Anyone on the internet? > 2️⃣ **Do you want any photos to be visible to the public outright?** > a) Yes – anyone can view all uploads. > b) No – only the owner can see their uploads; others can see a gallery but not the photos themselves. > 3️⃣ **Will you need to store any other private data?** > (e.g., emails, names, notes…?) > 4️⃣ **Do you already have a Supabase project?** > If not, we’ll guide you through creating one.
